digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute successfully with parseable verdicts before production cutover
All local gate invocations (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must demonstrate zero direct-Anthropic calls and exclusively use Bedrock inference profiles
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens observed across gate runs, not write-only behavior
Structured output must validate on all local gate runs without falling back to unparsed or INDETERMINATE shapes due to provider differences
Bedrock cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes matching Anthropic cache_control, causing no observable functional difference in cache behavior
Local Bedrock configuration must be reversible in one step via environment variable, and documentation must be added to docs/local-dev-env.md with no changes to infra/
